sources.entry: PlushSource MCP - MCP server that lets AI assistants search and compare the 55 custom plush manufacturers in the PlushSource directory (plushsource.com) by MOQ, lead time and OEM/ODM, with facts compiled from each manufacturer's website. #opensource #mcp #free

summary.one_liner: An MCP server and open, facts-only CSV/JSON dataset of 55 custom plush manufacturers from the PlushSource directory, searchable by MOQ, lead time and OEM/ODM.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides an MCP server (plushsource-mcp, TypeScript) that lets AI assistants search, filter, and compare custom plush manufacturers. Its tools cover free-text and facet search (country, category, MOQ range, certifications, design inputs, products, industries, OEM/ODM), fetching every fact for one manufacturer, side-by-side comparison of two to five manufacturers, listing available facets, and reporting dataset metadata. It also includes an rfq_draft prompt that turns a project brief into a shortlist of 3–5 manufacturers and an RFQ email. The same data is published as data/manufacturers.csv, a generated JSON file, and a MANUFACTURERS.md table grouped by country. According to the README, the server runs over stdio, needs no API key, and makes no network calls because the dataset is bundled in the package.
use_cases: find a custom plush manufacturer by MOQ or lead time
compare plush factories side by side
draft an RFQ email to plush suppliers
filter plush makers by OEM or ODM capability
use plush supplier data inside an AI assistant
how_to_run: npm run build (regenerates data files from the CSV and bundles dist/index.js)
node dist/index.js (starts the server on stdio)
notable: Facts-only dataset: empty fields mean the manufacturer does not publish that fact, and values are never estimated
Bundled dataset with no API key and no network calls at runtime
Data published in CSV, JSON and Markdown table formats, with a pull-request workflow for corrections
MOQ filters exclude records that do not publish an MOQ
Includes an rfq_draft prompt for turning a project brief into a shortlist and RFQ email
caveats: PlushSource does not independently audit or verify manufacturers; facts are as the manufacturers state them
A listing is not an endorsement, certification, ranking, or quality guarantee
PlushSource does not quote, sample, or take orders; users must contact manufacturers directly
